item.tib: ma cig srid rgyal nag mo'i mthu bsgrub kyi gsang bskang mdos kyi lag len zla dkar 'od gsal
item.coloph: de lta'i srid rgyal mdos gzhung gi lag len zla dkar gsal sgron 'di / mkha' 'gro'i lung bzhin gzhung lugs dang /bla ma'i phyag len ji bzhin du/ gab pa mngon byung ma nor bar/ rnal 'byor tshul 'dzin rgyal dbang gis/ bkod par byas la 'gal 'khrul gyis/ nyes skyon byung gyur dang*/ yi dam mkha' 'gro rnams la bshags/ dge mchis ma gyur 'gro drug gi sems can sangs rgyas rgyu gyur cig
